result.description: Podio (Progress/Citrix) is a customizable work-management and CRM platform with apps, workspaces, items, tasks and workflows.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 with client ID/secret: server-side, client-side, username/password, and app authentication (app ID + app token). API keys generated self-serve in account settings.
result.access_detail: Sign up for Podio, generate an API key in account settings. Free plan includes API access at 1000 calls/hour; higher limits via paid add-ons. No approval step documented.
result.api_notes: 43 API areas: Applications, Items, Tasks, Comments, Contacts, Files, Hooks, Spaces, Organizations, Search, Views, Flows, Batch, etc. Rate limit 1000 calls/hour on Free/Plus/Premium; add-ons raise it.

evidence.quote: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.
Your application is assigned a unique identifier, called "Client ID", together with a "Client Secret".
You just have to sign in or sign up with Podio, and go to the API key tab in your settings.
Our API is split up into different areas, that each contains a subset of methods grouped by functionality.
The Podio MCP Server is currently in beta and is intended for evaluation and testing.
The server is live at https://mcp.podio.com
